Point-in-time SQLite feature store and snapshot validator.
CFTC Legacy Futures-Only and TFF parsers with distinct taxonomies.
Event timeline, source-independence grouping and scenario/counter-hypothesis assembler.
Four deterministic baselines: naive class prior, momentum sign, mean-reversion sign and Gaussian volatility normal.

not_implemented_or_not_verified: No trained XRP-specific candidate model; walk-forward evaluates deterministic baselines only.
No mature synchronized historical dataset spanning spot, L2, derivatives, exchange flows, collateral and macro.
Current event registry has 73 curated events, zero non-null raw publisher SHA-256 receipts and zero model-eligible events.
No independent WORM store or trusted timestamp authority; raw receipt artifacts retain 90 days, per-run feature-store checkpoints seven days and daily archives 90 days.
No paired block-bootstrap confidence intervals or source-clustered uncertainty for model-versus-baseline Brier/log-loss differences.
Overlap-adjusted sample count does not remove residual serial dependence or common-source correlation.
PSI is univariate; multivariate and concept drift are not implemented.
No independent shadow cohort, trusted production evaluator key or measured candidate-model superiority.
Scheduled ingestion workflow is not on main and has no verified main-branch run.

main_workflow_findings: barrot-sync.yml is push-triggered on main, reads LunaRoute/GitHub secrets, suppresses sync failures and ignores git-push failures; no API-key disclosure was established by the inspected echo because cut -c1-30 prints only the fixed label.
barrot-agent.yml is issue-label-triggered with contents, pull-request and issue write permissions; integration quarantines it.

deploy-a2a-worker.yml deploys on pushes to a2a/** and uploads Cloudflare Worker secrets; integration changes it to manual dispatch, exact-main-SHA and separate deployment/secret-rotation confirmations.

barrot-ops.yml has a broad external-change confirmation and can overwrite a Databricks workspace path or download a Kaggle dataset; integration adds per-action confirmation and exact-source-SHA verification.
coinbase-paper-trader.yml is manual but writes paper state/logs to main and pushes; integration makes the simulation artifact-only with exact-SHA confirmation. It was not run.
main opencode.json enables remote LunaRoute MCP and allows edit/bash/webfetch; integration disables the remote MCP and changes mutations to ask.
xrp-public-ingestion.yml exists only on integration; it is read-only and main-ref guarded, but no main run exists.
